# Intergrax — Agent OS / Harness AI

**Positioning:** Harness AI & Agent OS — agents decide domain steps (`on_next_step` → `StepOutcome`); HarnessKernel executes policy/trace/state; NexusLoop orchestrates multi-agent Tasks; Tier-3 applications supply identity, profiles, and production gates. The Harness is the product; agents are replaceable. Canon: docs/project/architecture/AGENT_CONTRACTS_AND_ASSEMBLY.md §13–§40 · ADR-AGENT-001..003.
